name: marine_reef
story: 400 L mixed reef (tangs, a regal angelfish, SPS and LPS corals) in a Genoa apartment, run by a careful but busy owner. Starts in a late-summer heatwave where the chiller is essential. Autumn cools the flat, one weekly water change with cold tap-mixed water, a loose probe connector, a slowly drifting probe, an EMI spike from a new pump, a brief blackout, and a 3.3 V rail sag. Mid-month the owner unplugs the chiller for winter and forgets to disable cooling in the UI; later the heater element dies and gets replaced, a relay welds, a window is left open on a cold night, and evening room heating pushes the tank warm with no chiller.

events.note: Late-summer heatwave: flat at 31-34 C, shutters open, chiller works almost continuously.
EMI burst when the skimmer pump starts; one probe only, must be rejected without alarm storm.
Owner shifts photoperiod one hour later to cut midday heat; lights heat moves to evening.
Weekly 15% water change with slightly cool mixed water (-2.5 C); sudden step, heater should recover without overshoot.
Probe 2 connector loosened while cleaning the sump; reads open circuit. Expect probe-fault alarm and fail-safe both loads on.
Owner reseats the connector; controller must resume only after the fail-safe recheck interval.
Second weekly change, well matched temperature: negligible disturbance, no alarm.
Probe 0 NTC slowly ageing/creeping (+0.24 C/day). Fusion should flag the discordant probe within days.
Owner notices the probe discrepancy warning and replaces the NTC.
Evening blackout in the building: heater, chiller, pumps and controller off; tank coasts, controller reboots and relays must start de-energised.
3.3 V rail sags after a cheap USB supply swap; all channels and the ADC reference read 3% off. Expect ADC reference alarm and fail-safe.
Original power supply refitted, reference normal again.
Owner lowers setpoint to 25.0 C for winter (autumn cooling already underway); normal operation.
Third weekly change with cold autumn tap water mix: -3.5 C step, heater must cope, fish stress only mild.
Probe 1 reading frozen (ADC channel latch / cracked wire). Expect frozen-probe detection and fail-safe once the others move.
Owner reboots and re-seats the probe cable.
Planned reboot for OTA firmware update, should come back in fail-safe then regulate normally.
Room is at ~19 C; owner unplugs the chiller to save electricity and noise for winter but leaves cooling enabled in the UI.
Heater internal thermostat welds ON (limescale/age). Only the controller relay can stop the heater now; welded thermostat with working controller must not overheat.
Owner notices warm tank and replaces the heater (new thermostat).
Evening room heating on in winter (radiators 17-23), repeated below.
Evening room heating on again; with lights and no chiller the tank rises above setpoint.
Owner finally disables cooling in the UI since the chiller is unplugged; no chiller short-cycle alarms afterwards.
Heater element burns out (stat clicks but draws nothing). Expect actuator-stall alarm on heater, tank falls slowly with room at ~16 C.
Spare heater installed in the sump.
Window left open on a freezing night; room drops to ~7 C, heater needs near-full power.
Heating relay contacts weld closed after an inrush spike (heater cannot be cut by controller). Expect welded-relay alarm; internal stat still limits.
Relay board replaced.

expect: Heatwave day 0-3: chiller cycles with 5 min anti-short-cycle, tank stays under ~28 C; no overtemp (>27.5) alarm unless heatwave exceeds chiller capacity.

Probe open (h110), stuck (h380), spike (h30), drift (h200) and ADC gain 0.97 (h288): probe/ADC-reference alarms and fail-safe (both loads powered) only during the real fault plus the recheck interval; the 3 s spike must not alarm.
Power outage h270 (3 h): tank cools a little but no overtemp/undertemp; controller reboots into fail-safe then regulates.

Chiller unplugged h480 with enableCool still true: firmware may legitimately command cooling with no effect (possible chiller actuator-stall alarm, not a false alarm); overtemp alarm should fire during evening room heating (h544-551) if tank exceeds 27.5.

Heater dead (h590) and welded heat relay (h640) must raise actuator-stall and welded-relay alarms respectively; open-window night (h615) should NOT raise undertemp unless tank falls below 22.5, and water changes (h84, h336) should not raise false alarms.
